Synthetic portraits used only as placement fixtures. No customer, family, celebrity, or found photographs.

Each JPEG is an original image of a fictional person generated for this repository on 2026-10-26. They are not downloads. See ../../FIXTURES.md for the licence.

Landmarks in the matching .json files are MediaPipe Face Landmarker output (Python mediapipe 1.1, model assets/vision/face_landmarker.task). They are normalized x, y, z for the 478 face points, measured on the JPEG in this folder.

| File | Subject | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| malayali-beard.jpg | Fictional man with a beard, outdoors | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| glasses-beard.jpg | Fictional older man, glasses and beard | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| glasses-outdoor.jpg | Fictional man with glasses, outdoors | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| curly-freckles.jpg | Fictional man with curly hair, close portrait | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| face-portrait.jpg | Fictional close crop, chin outside the frame | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| woman-pink.jpg | Fictional woman, hand beside the cheek | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| phone-smile.jpg | Fictional woman indoors, glasses, phone in hand | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| turned-beanie.jpg | Fictional man turned well away from the camera | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |
| bindi-smile.jpg | Fictional woman with a bindi and headscarf | Lookuvi synthetic fixture |

face-portrait.jpg is the generated close crop with a thin strip removed from the bottom so the chin landmark falls outside the frame. Landmarks were measured again after that crop.
